C0079.title: MIIT Cracks Down on Malicious “Shake-to-Jump” Ads During 618 Shopping Festival
C0079.summary: On June 9, 2026, in response to rampant splash-screen pop-ups and highly sensitive “shake-to-jump” ads that maliciously redirect users during the 618 promotion, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology ordered companies to conduct self-inspections and rectifications.
